svg.text: A short guideline is enclosed to consolidate policy on the use of symbols to

text.font-family: ManualKit Courier, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Courier New, monospace

svg.text: identity Province of British Columbia activities and programs.

text.font-family: ManualKit Courier, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Courier New, monospace

svg.text: There is increased flexibility for Ministries and Crown Corporations to use the

text.font-family: ManualKit Courier, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Courier New, monospace

svg.text: Provincial Flag Wordmark in place of the Stylized Coat of Arms, Where appropriate.

text.font-family: ManualKit Courier, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Courier New, monospace

svg.text: This is an evolving change, to be made on new projects and new materials without

text.font-family: ManualKit Courier, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Courier New, monospace

svg.text: incurring unnecessary replacement, painting or reprinting costs.

text.font-family: ManualKit Courier, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Courier New, monospace

svg.text: At the back of the guidelines, three examples are included of use of the

text.font-family: ManualKit Courier, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Courier New, monospace

svg.text: Provincial Flag Wordmark or Stylized Flag and Theme on advertising, including routine
